summary: SOS Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 16, 2026, providing notice of an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) on July 27, 2026, to propose a share capital reduction reducing par value of Class A and Class B ordinary shares from $0.75 to $0.0000001, with the resulting credit transferred to a distributable reserve. The filing includes a proxy statement and card; no specific price, premium, or advisor is mentioned. The registrant is the issuer. No special-situation event (e.g., acquisition, activist campaign) is triggered; this is a routine capital structure proposal, equivalent to a US company seeking shareholder approval for a par value reduction.
